name: VS Code, GitHub & developer tools
description: Visual Studio Code, GitHub and GitHub Copilot, Visual Studio and Microsoft developer platforms.

items.title: GitHub adds REST API controls for AI Scan on repositories
items.summary: GitHub added a public-preview REST API setting to enable or disable AI Scan for repositories at organization and repository levels. The `repository_scan` setting lets teams manage rollouts programmatically, including through scripts and infrastructure as code, rather than configuring each location manually.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.111 adds enterprise permission-rule support
items.summary: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.111 adds regular-expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash, and PowerShell permission rules, plus an option allowing remote clients to create sessions for a single launch. The release also includes usage-display, authentication, and terminal usability fixes.

items.title: C++ Dynamic Debugging becomes generally available in Visual Studio 2026
items.summary: C++ Dynamic Debugging is now generally available in all Visual Studio 2026 channels and in MSVC Build Tools 14.52. It deoptimizes functions when a developer sets a breakpoint or steps into code, making it easier to inspect optimized or release builds without switching to a separate debug build.

items.title: GitHub Actions will retire ARM32 Linux and Windows hosted-runner support
items.summary: GitHub Actions hosted runners will stop supporting ARM32 job execution on Windows and Linux on December 8, 2026, including native AArch32 user-space execution. The change is tied to Node 24's lack of ARM32 support, so affected workflows will need to migrate before the cutoff.

items.title: GitHub secret scanning adds detection for Cloudflare service tokens
items.summary: GitHub secret scanning now automatically detects Cloudflare Access service tokens (`cloudflare_access_service_token`) in repositories. Partner secrets found in public repositories are reported to the issuer through GitHub's secret-scanning partnership program, while user secrets can generate alerts in public or private repositories.

items.title: Bring Your Own Model becomes generally available in Visual Studio
items.summary: Bring Your Own Model is now generally available in Visual Studio 18.12, allowing developers to use provider, self-hosted, or local models without leaving the IDE. The release adds multiple named configurations, custom endpoints and local-model support, API-format controls, and improved proxy handling; GitHub sign-in is not required.

items.title: GitHub makes issue types and fields available for personal accounts
items.summary: GitHub made issue types and issue fields generally available for repositories owned by personal accounts, bringing customizable planning features to individual developers and open-source maintainers. Users can configure up to 25 types and 25 fields and manage them through projects, APIs, and webhooks.

items.title: Microsoft publishes Go 1.27.4-1 and 1.26.11-1 builds with security fixes
items.summary: Microsoft made Go builds v1.27.4-1 and v1.26.11-1 available, including security fixes. The announcement links each build to its corresponding upstream Go release notes.

items.title: GitHub Apps can manage enterprise Copilot seats through APIs
items.summary: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now call Copilot seat-management APIs to control which users and enterprise teams receive seats, using a new fine-grained permission named “Enterprise Copilot license management.” The announcement was published after the previous monitoring run and enables app-based management of enterprise Copilot assignments.

items.title: Visual Studio Code 1.146 becomes the stable release
items.summary: VS Code 1.146 was released on the Stable channel on November 11. Highlights include experimental inbox mode, preview model comparisons and separate chat windows, extensions in the Agents window, and a migration notice for the Local harness before its planned removal in February 2027.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon becomes available in GitHub Copilot
items.summary: Gemini 4 Carbon is now generally available in GitHub Copilot for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks, with a focus on secure code generation. It is available to Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise users across clients including VS Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI and the coding agent, and uses provider list pricing under usage-based billing.

items.title: Microsoft опубликовала ноябрьские обновления .NET и .NET Framework, включая исправления безопасности
items.summary: Microsoft выпустила ноябрьские сервисные обновления для .NET 8, 9 и 10 с исправлениями безопасности и другими исправлениями. В опубликованных бюллетенях также перечислены затрагивающие .NET и Visual Studio уязвимости, включая несколько проблем удалённого выполнения кода в Visual Studio.

items.title: Microsoft выпустила .NET 11
items.summary: Microsoft выпустила .NET 11 с изменениями в C# 15, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, SDK и библиотеках платформы. Среди новшеств — возможности для AI-разработки, оптимизации выполнения и инструменты, призванные ускорить повседневные рабочие процессы разработчиков.

items.title: Project Zenith стал доступен на AMD Ryzen AI Halo
items.summary: Project Zenith — подготовленная для разработчиков среда Windows 11 — стала доступна с предустановкой на AMD Ryzen AI Halo с процессором Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495. Среда включает VS Code, Git и инструменты GitHub и Azure, а также Python, Node.js, .NET, PowerShell 7 и WSL, упрощая начало локальной разработки и работы с AI.

items.title: GitHub secret scanning теперь обнаруживает секреты в логах GitHub Actions
items.summary: GitHub Secret Scanning теперь может искать секреты в логах GitHub Actions после завершения workflow, а обнаружения отображаются в списке оповещений репозитория со ссылкой на соответствующий лог. Функция доступна в публичном preview и расширяет мониторинг за пределы кода, issues, wiki, discussions и pull requests.

items.title: Windows App Development CLI v0.8 добавляет WinUI DevTools, профилирование и поддержку C++
items.summary: Microsoft выпустила WinApp CLI 0.8.0 с экспериментальными WinUI DevTools для инспектирования и проверки изменений в работающем приложении, а также с профилированием производительности и поддержкой C++-проектов. Инструменты помогают разработчикам исследовать интерфейс и производительность приложений и собирать проекты Visual Studio C++ через CLI.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 стала доступна в GitHub Copilot
items.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 теперь доступна в GitHub Copilot для сложных многоэтапных задач по большим кодовым базам. Модель доступна подписчикам Copilot Pro+, Max, Business и Enterprise в VS Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, coding agent и других клиентах; включение для организаций может требовать действий администраторов, а развёртывание идёт постепенно.

items.title: GitHub анонсировал проекты в приложении Copilot для координации работы
items.summary: GitHub рассказал о Projects в приложении Copilot: проект может объединять работу в одном или нескольких репозиториях, а также задачи, не привязанные к репозиторию. Copilot может запускать сессии, настраивать повторяющиеся автоматизации и создавать материалы, которые отображаются в проекте.

items.title: Microsoft introduces SharePoint MCP tools in Work IQ
items.summary: Microsoft announced SharePoint MCP tools in preview for Work IQ, enabling custom apps and agents to discover and perform SharePoint tasks such as finding files, managing lists, and handling approvals. Calls use the signed-in user’s identity and permissions, and the tools use runtime discovery across a catalog of more than 60 operations.

items.title: Copilot code review adds API management and a more compact review overview
items.summary: GitHub added REST and GraphQL API management for Copilot code-review settings, covering enterprise policy through individual repositories. The update also makes review summaries more compact and adds improvements for review credits, automatic-review bypasses, and repeated reviews.

items.title: Copilot impact dashboard adds Chat and VS Code agent usage
items.summary: GitHub expanded the Copilot impact dashboard and enterprise/organization 28-day reports to track Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, bringing the chart to nine experiences. It also renamed the “Passive users” cohort to “Chat-first users”; adoption-phase rules remain unchanged.

items.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 2
items.summary: GitHub’s weekly Copilot release roundup described updates across its app, CLI, JetBrains, Xcode, and VS Code. Notable additions include Agent Merge controls in pull requests and VS Code local automations with cron expressions and workspace custom agents; the roundup also recaps Copilot’s IDE integrations and agent-session improvements.

items.title: @GitHub in Slack and Teams reaches general availability
items.summary: GitHub made @GitHub in Slack and Teams generally available, enabling users to investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes, and open pull requests from conversations. Teams users can also review plans and code changes in Canvas, while onboarding and attribution were improved.

items.title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API adds code-review details and addressed rate
items.summary: GitHub added code-review feedback details to enterprise and organization Copilot usage metrics, including counts of comments evaluated and addressed and a per-repository addressed rate. The new breakdowns give administrators more information for assessing Copilot code-review outcomes.

items.title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
items.summary: GitHub added per-user telemetry and version-compliance fields, plus aggregate counts, to Copilot usage metrics reports. The additions help administrators identify why usage reports may lack details and which users may need follow-up.

items.title: Microsoft presents Copilot upgrade agent for .NET Windows Arm64 migration
items.summary: Microsoft described using the GitHub Copilot upgrade agent to assess and update .NET applications for Windows Arm64, including dependencies, platform assumptions, and project configuration. Developers can review proposed changes, but the post notes that a successful build is not a substitute for runtime testing on Windows Arm64.

items.title: GitHub secret scanning adds SpaceX partnership and upgrades detectors
items.summary: GitHub added SpaceX to its secret-scanning partnership program and introduced detection for a Starlink API secret. It also upgraded detectors for Alibaba, AWS, Google, OpenVSX, Pydantic Services, and Tencent with additional false-positive filtering, expanding coverage and refining alerts.

items.title: Microsoft shows how to run agentic coding locally with Foundry Local and GitHub Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft described a local agentic-coding workflow that runs Qwen3.8-27B through Foundry Local and connects it to GitHub Copilot. The on-device approach is presented as offering more privacy, predictable inference costs, and continued work without a network connection.

items.title: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves query accuracy, metadata, and CLI security checks
items.summary: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves query accuracy across several languages, corrects query metadata, and adds security checks when bundling or publishing packs. The CLI also directs JVM warnings and initialization errors to standard error, preventing interference with machine-readable output.

items.title: GitHub Copilot plans to end support for JetBrains IDEs 2025.2.x
items.summary: Microsoft announced that the GitHub Copilot plugin will end support for JetBrains IDEs version 2025.2.x in the coming months, moving the minimum supported version to 2025.3.x. Existing installations are not expected to be immediately disabled, but users on affected versions may lose compatibility with future plugin updates and will no longer receive new features, fixes, or performance improvements for that IDE version.

items.title: Intelligent Terminal 0.3 adds agent-focused sidebar, session search, and headless mode
items.summary: Intelligent Terminal 0.3 adds a sidebar for managing tabs and agent sessions, global search, agent filtering, and live status indicators. It can also keep selected tabs running in headless mode after the terminal window closes, and automatically detects supported agent CLIs for the new-tab menu.

items.title: GitHub Copilot becomes available in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant
items.summary: GitHub Copilot is now available in public preview within Xcode’s built-in coding assistant, starting with Xcode 27.3 beta. The separate GitHub Copilot for Xcode extension remains available, giving developers a native alternative rather than requiring migration.

items.title: Visual Studio Code 1.145 adds remote-agent previews, cron schedules, and chat controls
items.summary: VS Code 1.145 adds the ability to preview apps and use canvases from remote agent sessions in the Agents window, along with cron-based automation schedules and chat-noise controls. The stable release was dated November 4, 2026.

items.title: WinApp VS Code extension v0.4 previews project-aware WinUI XAML IntelliSense
items.summary: Microsoft released WinApp VS Code extension v0.4, adding an experimental preview of project-aware IntelliSense for WinUI XAML, a command to create WinUI apps, and the ability to build and run projects from VS Code. The extension is available in public preview, with full project-aware support for C# WinUI projects requiring the .NET 10 SDK.

items.title: Dependabot version updates add support for Agent Package Manager
items.summary: Dependabot now supports version updates for Agent Package Manager dependencies, opening pull requests for supported Git dependencies declared in apm.yml and regenerating apm.lock.yaml when present. The feature is generally available on github.com across plans; this update does not include security updates.

items.title: Copilot usage API separates BYOK and enterprise custom-model usage
items.summary: GitHub updated the Copilot usage metrics API to separately identify local BYOK activity and requests using enterprise custom models. The added reporting helps organizations review model usage and distinguish provider-billed or local-model use from Copilot-hosted usage; existing totals remain unchanged.

items.title: Dependabot adds support for Python 3.15
items.summary: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15, allowing projects using the new version to continue receiving updates. GitHub says support is available to all github.com users and will be included in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.

items.title: GitHub REST API adds a cost-center lookup for resources
items.summary: GitHub added a REST API endpoint to look up the cost center associated with a user, organization, repository, or enterprise team. The response returns the cost-center ID and name, simplifying billing and cost-center workflows that previously required scanning cost-center resource lists; access depends on the caller’s role.

items.title: GitHub Copilot becomes available in JetBrains Air
items.summary: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air, where users can delegate coding tasks, work across parallel agent sessions, and review results in context. Cloud tasks can run through Air Teams using the user’s existing Copilot subscription rather than JetBrains AI credits.

items.title: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 and JSON data-extension support
items.summary: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds support for Python 3.15 features, JSON syntax for data extensions, C23 bit-precise integers, and query-accuracy improvements. The update also changes the GitHub Actions control-flow graph implementation, which may require developers with custom queries to adjust them.

items.title: GitHub security risk assessments now show repository protection status
items.summary: GitHub’s code security and secret risk assessments now indicate whether findings are in protected or unprotected repositories, helping organizations spot where to extend security coverage. The improvement is available in GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Team; secret risk assessment support is slated for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows weekly update highlights hardening and cost-aware routing
items.summary: GitHub’s November 2 Agentic Workflows roundup describes safer pull-request outputs, optional actions-lock integration, guided remediation, and additional workflows adopting model routing to keep lower-cost work economical. The post reports these project updates and notes that release v1.0.1 itself was published October 27.

items.title: Microsoft summarizes October Azure Developer CLI releases and features
items.summary: Microsoft’s October Azure Developer CLI roundup covers releases 1.35.0 through 1.37.2. Highlights include deployment previews across multiple Azure services, Container Apps express deployments, a beta command for removing stored environment values, and support for extension-defined infrastructure providers in generated pipelines.

items.title: GitHub app in Microsoft Teams reaches general availability
items.summary: The GitHub app in Microsoft Teams is now generally available, letting teams work with GitHub and Copilot in the context of their chats, channels, and meeting chats. Users can ask in natural language to select or switch repositories and choose which Copilot model to use for a task.

items.title: Visual Studio 2026 version 18.11.3 addresses security advisories
items.summary: Microsoft released Visual Studio 2026 version 18.11.3 on October 29 with security advisory fixes. The listed issues include a libcurl HTTP/2 upload use-after-free, a Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write, and a Visual Studio certificate-validation vulnerability.

items.title: GitHub adds webhook delivery IP ranges to the Meta API
items.summary: GitHub added three webhook delivery IP ranges to the Meta API’s `hooks` field. Operators maintaining static allowlists should add the prefixes to avoid rejecting deliveries; the change applies across GitHub.com plans, including Enterprise Cloud.

items.title: Microsoft details vcpkg’s October update, including configurable cache compression
items.summary: Microsoft summarized October changes to vcpkg, including a configurable binary-cache compression level, improved cache diagnostics and reliability, and updated ports such as Boost 1.92.0. The compression option lets developers trade ZIP archive size against cache submission time.

items.title: Microsoft and Syncfusion collaborate on open-source Blazor toolkit and contributions
items.summary: Microsoft announced a collaboration with Syncfusion to advance Blazor. Syncfusion has released a free, MIT-licensed component toolkit and contributed fixes and tests to ASP.NET Core and .NET scaffolding, adding reusable components while contributing directly to the platform.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot harness enters public preview in Foundry Agent Service
items.summary: Microsoft introduced the Copilot harness in Foundry Agent Service as a public preview, giving developers a managed way to build agents that reason, use tools, and complete complex, long-running tasks. The post also announced general availability of long-running resilience for hosted agents.

items.title: Visual Studio Marketplace adds secretless Trusted Publishing for extensions
items.summary: Microsoft announced Trusted Publishing for Visual Studio Marketplace extensions. GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines can use verified federated identity to publish without storing a long-lived personal access token or publishing secret; existing PAT-based publishing remains available.

items.title: Microsoft makes Copilot UX components generally available with SPFx 1.24
items.summary: Microsoft made Copilot UX components generally available worldwide with SharePoint Framework 1.24, allowing developers to bring interactive dashboards, forms, and business actions into Copilot conversations. Components can also be reused in SharePoint, Teams, and Outlook; users need a Microsoft Copilot add-on license to render them in Copilot.

items.title: Copilot code review adds Max effort preview and generally available approvals
items.summary: GitHub added a Max effort level for Copilot code review in public preview and made Copilot approvals generally available. The combination is intended to provide a deeper review and an approval assessment within the pull-request review workflow.

items.title: Visual Studio Code 1.144 stable release expands agent workflows and continuity
items.summary: VS Code 1.144 shipped in the stable channel with expanded agent workflows, including agent sessions that continue across environments and client continuity supported by the Agent Host Protocol. The release also brings agent management and model-selection updates, making it a substantial IDE update for developers using Copilot agents.

items.title: GitHub brings Copilot Agent Merge into cloud pull requests
items.summary: GitHub integrated Agent Merge into pull requests on GitHub.com. Copilot can watch for blockers such as failing Actions workflows and merge conflicts and attempt to fix them; the cloud feature is available to paid Copilot users subject to organization and enterprise policies.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion reaches general availability for model routing
items.summary: Copilot Fusion is now generally available, letting users delegate model selection and orchestration to Copilot instead of choosing a model for each task. It is available across all Copilot plans in VS Code, the GitHub Copilot app, Copilot CLI, and JetBrains IDEs, with Standard, High, and Max effort levels.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.105 fixes Fusion effort selection in long-context sessions
items.summary: Copilot CLI 1.0.105 fixes an issue that prevented users from selecting Copilot Fusion High or Max from /model during long-context sessions. The official release page records publication on October 28.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows reaches general availability
items.summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows is generally available on GitHub.com for Free, Team, and Enterprise. It lets users define reasoning-based automations in Markdown for compilation into GitHub Actions workflows, with GA additions including self-hosted runner support, improved budget forecasting, model routing, and stronger agent isolation.

items.title: Copilot Fusion previews intelligent routing between local and cloud models
items.summary: Copilot Fusion’s experimental preview can route requests between supported on-device and cloud models in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and VS Code. The announcement includes managed Windows setup for MAI Code 1.1 Flash and support for manually configured local models; it notes that routing still makes decisions in the cloud.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app adds Projects and computer use in public preview
items.summary: The GitHub Copilot app introduced Projects in public preview, providing a home for work spanning repositories and sessions. It also announced computer use in public preview on macOS and Windows, allowing Copilot to interact with desktop applications, including apps without APIs or MCP integrations.

items.title: GitHub Enterprise begins including access to Copilot for licensed users
items.summary: GitHub Enterprise customers working with a GitHub or Microsoft account team can now include Copilot access for each licensed user, with AI-credit budgeting applying to some capabilities. This changes how eligible enterprises manage Copilot access, while self-serve subscriptions remain unaffected and will receive availability in stages.

items.title: GitHub Copilot previews natural-language image generation and editing
items.summary: Copilot users can now generate and edit images with natural-language instructions without leaving Copilot. The feature is in public preview for Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise plans, with image-token usage billed separately and counted against plan AI credits.

items.title: GitHub rolls out shared Copilot Automations for teams
items.summary: Shared Copilot Automations let teams build and maintain AI-powered workflows together in repositories. Automations are visible to repository readers, editable by those with write access, and billed to the repository owner; GitHub says rollout is underway for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise plans.

items.title: GitHub introduces intelligence features for Copilot memory, context, and code search
items.summary: GitHub announced a context and learning layer for agents, including Copilot Memory, now generally available on paid plans, and Copilot dreaming, in public preview. Memory can carry personal preferences and repository conventions across sessions and clients, while dreaming reviews prior work to improve future agent sessions.

items.title: GitHub previews a Security extension for the Copilot app
items.summary: GitHub introduced a public-preview Security extension in the Copilot app that surfaces repository code-scanning alerts and lets users ask Copilot to explain or help fix them. The preview is available on github.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency; Enterprise Server is not supported.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows introduces a pre-run admission gate
items.summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows now documents an opt-in admission gate that can consult a separately deployed authority before an agent session starts. The authority can approve or deny activation and return AI-credit allowances, enabling centralized policy and budgeting; the post emphasizes this is cooperative, not a hard quota.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.104 changes Auto model selection and Autopilot task waiting
items.summary: Copilot CLI 1.0.104 changes managed fusion sessions to start on Auto and apply fusionTier settings. Interactive and SDK Autopilot sessions now continue waiting for attached background tasks instead of stopping at the configured timeout; `-p --autopilot` still honors that timeout.

items.title: VS Code adds configurable eagerness for GitHub Copilot inline suggestions
items.summary: VS Code now lets paid GitHub Copilot subscribers choose low, medium, or high eagerness for inline suggestions. The settings let developers tune how proactively Copilot offers suggestions and how large its proposed edits are.

items.title: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions reach general availability
items.summary: GitHub made Copilot assisted permissions generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and VS Code. The mode automatically proceeds with requests judged clearly safe and requires user approval for other requests; enterprise administrators can manage access to the mode.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra becomes generally available in GitHub Copilot
items.summary: GPT-6.1 Terra is now generally available in GitHub Copilot for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users, with rollout across VS Code, Visual Studio, CLI, the cloud agent, and other clients. GitHub positions it for everyday agentic coding and terminal work at a lower cost than GPT-6.1 Sol; usage-based billing follows provider list pricing.

items.title: Visual Studio adds resumable, unsaved Markdown investigation notes
items.summary: Visual Studio 2026 version 18.11 can create standalone Markdown notes, and the opt-in Hot Exit preview can restore unsaved notes after Visual Studio is closed and reopened. This helps developers resume investigations without having to save the note or add it to a project first.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows weekly update highlights hardening and safer credential handling
items.summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows’ October 26 weekly update recaps six hardening releases, emphasizing stronger static analysis, safer credential handling, and clearer diagnostics. Highlighted changes include network credentials for safe-output integration jobs and secret-safe error diagnostics for engine-driver crashes.
